hypotheses: Inside the loop the clarifier reads the owner's words with the agent's last reply, the owner's recent messages and repository facts, and acts only on a change to the system being built. A gap with a better-supported option becomes a labelled, flippable assumption; every gap whose answer changes what gets built is asked as soon as it arises, specific, with options and a recommendation, through the question tool, those that hinge on one principle asked once as that principle, with no limit per turn (SR-361). The question rules are written once, in the iaso-records skill, and iaso-clarify points to it (SR-379); the hooks remind the agent to ask, and outside the intent loop only an edit that contradicts or extends a confirmed record waits, until the owner answers or a loop reaches clear intent; every other edit goes ahead, and a waiting question never blocks an unrelated edit; inside the loop, edits wait while the loop's gate is closed, because the loop does not build until its judge step passes (gate.sh; SR-378, DEC-391, DEC-410). The owner never reads the interpretation itself. The owner's answers are logged as their words and never asked again; nothing of the clarifier's self-questioning is recorded.

given the agent's last reply listed review findings, when the owner says 'resolve all of the findings using a workflow', then no question asks which findings: the interpretation assumes the findings listed above and the work goes on
given the agent diagnosed why the panel does not show, when the owner says 'apply the proposed fixes for this issue', then no question asks which issue

given the owner refers to an issue found in another recent chat of the same project, when the clarifier runs, then it reads that chat's last reply and the owner's last messages there, and no question asks which issue
given the repository is a git repository, when the clarifier runs, then it never says the folder is not a git repository
given the transcript cannot be read, when the clarifier runs, then it runs on the owner's words alone
given the conversation was compacted, when the clarifier runs, then the agent's last reply and the compaction summary are given, and the summary is never taken as the owner's words

given the owner types '/iaso intent claude plugin update iaso@iaso' or '/iaso intent are there anything to merge on main?', when the clarifier reads it, then it finds no change to the system being built, writes no record and asks nothing

given the owner types '/iaso intent make the status line show the branch name', when the clarifier reads it, then a loop opens and its blocking questions, if any, come through the question tool in that turn
given a request that maps fully to a confirmed requirement, when the clarifier runs, then no question is asked and the loop goes on
given the request "reminders must always arrive instantly", when the clarifier interprets it, then the interpretation carries the assumption "instantly means within a minute" and no question is asked
given a request with three open gaps, each with a recommended option, when the clarifier runs, then three labelled assumptions and no question

given the request "let users export their data" with format and scope unspecified, and four drafted questions, one answered by a confirmed record and one whose options build the same thing, when the clarifier settles its questions, then exactly the two that change what gets built are asked through the question tool, ranked, with suggested answers and a recommended one; the other gaps are labelled assumptions

given the request "never keep anyone's email address, and email them their reminders", when the clarifier runs, then exactly one question is asked through the question tool, since the answer changes what gets built

given a request that could change a public interface two ways, neither favoured by any record or the conversation, when the clarifier runs, then one question is asked with both ways and what each costs to undo, through the question tool (no question goes to the study room, INT-114)

given a request with two or three gaps and no better-supported option for any, when the clarifier returns them, then all are asked with the question tool in the same turn, before building, not one per turn and never on a card; no spec session is offered for the count alone

given the agent needs to know now or later, a name, or which of two files the owner meant, when it asks, then the question tool asks it, as the rulebook (iaso-records) says and iaso-clarify points to (SR-379)
given the owner answers a question with 'whatever works', when the agent reads the answer, then the question is asked again; no option is taken for the owner

given the owner answered the clarifier's questions through the question tool, when the loop goes on, then the answers are logged as the owner's words and carried by the interpretation, and nothing asks them again
given any clarification, when it ends, then nothing about the clarifier's self-questioning is recorded and nothing waits on it
given a question that needs the idea of a confirmed requirement, when it is put to the owner, then it explains that idea in one plain sentence before using it, and names no record id

given the interpretation has four will lines, one won't and two assumptions, when the owner is asked the remaining question, then the owner sees the question and its options only, never the will, won't or assumed lines
